name: @comchatx/cx-amazon-claims-playbook
description: Checks what Amazon may owe you, and says where to claim.
author: ComChatX

comchatx.name: Amazon Claims Playbook
comchatx.about: 核对亚马逊可能该赔的货和钱，说明每类去哪索赔。

warehouse-claims.zh: 查出亚马逊仓库里丢失或损坏、还没赔的货。
warehouse-claims.en: Units lost or damaged in Amazon's warehouses, not yet paid.

shipment-claims.zh: 核对入库少收，以及移除没送到的货。
shipment-claims.en: Shipments received short, and removals that never came back.

return-claims.zh: 找出退款了却没退回、或退回不对的订单。
return-claims.en: Refunds whose item never came back, or came back wrong.

fee-claims.zh: 查出按错尺寸、重量或类目多收的费用。
fee-claims.en: Fees charged on the wrong size, weight or category.

claim-value.zh: 看清赔偿按什么价算，哪些又被撤回。
claim-value.en: What a reimbursement was worth, and when it was taken back.

claim-filing.zh: 说明索赔在哪提交、要什么证据、期限在哪查。
claim-filing.en: Where each claim is filed, its evidence, and where its window is stated.

claims-audit.zh: 查一遍亚马逊可能该赔的货和钱，以及各自去哪索赔。

shipment-claims.zh: 查最近几批入库有没有少收，差多少、要什么证据。

return-claims.zh: 找出退款了但没退回、或退回不对的订单。

fee-claims.zh: 查 FBA 费用有没有按错尺寸、重量或类目收。

claim-value.zh: 看亚马逊的赔偿按什么价算、有没有被撤回的。
